:::{#def-cartesian-product-many}
#### Cartesian product of several sets

For a [natural number](number-systems.qmd#def-natural-numbers) $n$
and [sets](#def-set) $A_1, A_2, \ldots, A_n$,
the **Cartesian product**
[@wikipedia_cartesian_product]
$A_1 \times A_2 \times \cdots \times A_n$
is the [set](#def-set) of $n$-[tuples](#def-tuple)
whose $i$th entry is in $A_i$ for each $i$:

$$A_1 \times \cdots \times A_n \eqdef \set{(a_1, \ldots, a_n) : a_i \in A_i \text{ for each } i}$$

:::
